services.name: Swim Lessons
services.desc: Have your kids become better swimmers, learn stroke mechanics, and the essential fundamentals needed to become competitive swimmers! Entry into competitive swimming can be intimidating but we’ve designed a program that is laid back, requires no fund raising or volunteer work, and is friendly to your summer vacation schedule. The program runs for 4 weeks, 5x a week, on weekday mornings before the competition pool opens to all patrons. Participants are not required to come to every practice session. Don’t stress!
